title: Hyperfine no-effect trap: 1.8% difference inside overlapping s.d.
what: Mean difference (~1.8% / ~7.4 ms) is within overlapping ±1 s.d. noise (no reliable speedup)

reader_questions.question: How large is the mean runtime difference between candidate and baseline?
Is the candidate reliably faster than baseline?
reader_questions.expected: No; the 7.4 ms gap is well inside the ±1 s.d. noise (±18.5 ms and ±19.2 ms) with heavily overlapping runs.

reader_questions.question: Should the PR claim a verified speedup from this benchmark?
reader_questions.expected: No; there is no evidence of a real speedup beyond measurement noise.
